findings.note: Because Game 3 was a blowout, Milwaukee's top relievers Uribe, Ashby and closer Megill rested and will be ready for Tuesday's possible clincher. The page confirms Games 1 and 2 were close, ending 3-2 and 5-4. No Game 4 starters, injury news or analyst picks on the total were found.
In Game 3 at Tropicana Field, Milwaukee beat ALCS MVP Freddy Peralta and the Rays bullpen 10-1 with 16 hits and an eight-run fifth inning, so this offense can run past a 7-run total on its own.

Before Game 3, Milwaukee's bullpen had a 1.24 ERA over 50 2/3 postseason innings, and Ashby had not allowed a run. The Rays' four-run first inning in Game 2 was their only scoring, which points to low run totals once the Brewers go to their bullpen.
